name: cadence
description: Ambient context for Codex: embodied signals, cadence dials, and a practical read-the-room lens. macOS-only alpha.

interface.longDescription: Cadence lets Codex inspect your self-reported state, ambient signals, git rhythm, and pinned response dials, then use that context as an advisory lens for pace, tone, posture, and proactivity.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my current cadence and use it to shape your response.
